### Props

| Name       | Type            | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | --------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `widgets`  | `Array<object>` |          | `[]`    | Widget entries for this slot from the v2 manifest page. Each entry: `{ widgetKey, slot, gridX, gridY, gridWidth, gridHeight, props? }`. |
| `slotName` | `string`        | ✓        | —       | The slot name this grid is rendering for (e.g. "body", "sidebar", "tab:general").                                                       |
| `registry` | `union`         |          | `null`  | Consumer registry override. When provided, overrides the injected cnRegistry. Used for standalone testing.                              |
